name: QuillBot
tagline: AI writing tools for paraphrasing, grammar checking, humanizing, and summarizing - used by 35 million writers worldwide.
description: QuillBot is an AI-powered writing platform offering paraphrasing, grammar checking, AI humanization, plagiarism detection, summarization, and translation tools. Founded in 2017 at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, it now serves over 35 million users across 180 countries. The platform is owned by Learneo, Inc. and includes integrations with Google Docs, Microsoft Word, and all major browsers.

Humanizing AI-generated text
Grammar and spelling correction
Summarizing long documents
Plagiarism checking
Translating text across 45+ languages
Generating citations (APA, MLA, Chicago)
Detecting AI-generated content

AI Humanizer to convert AI-generated text to natural-sounding prose
Advanced Grammar Checker with real-time corrections
AI Detector to identify AI-written content
Plagiarism Checker comparing against billions of web sources
Multi-language Translator supporting 45+ languages
Summarizer for condensing long texts
Citation Generator for APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, and IEEE formats
Google Docs and Microsoft Word native integration
Browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge

faqs.question: What is QuillBot used for?
faqs.answer: QuillBot is used to paraphrase, rewrite, humanize AI text, check grammar, detect plagiarism, summarize documents, translate content, and generate academic citations.

faqs.question: Does QuillBot have a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The free plan includes basic paraphrasing (125-word limit, 2 modes), grammar checking, summarization, translation up to 5,000 characters, and a citation generator.

faqs.question: How much does QuillBot Premium cost?
faqs.answer: QuillBot Premium costs $19.95/month on monthly billing, $13.31/month on a semi-annual plan ($39.95 every 3 months), or $8.33/month on an annual plan ($99.95/year).

faqs.question: Can QuillBot humanize AI-generated text?
faqs.answer: Yes. QuillBot's AI Humanizer tool rewrites AI-generated content to sound more natural, helping it pass AI detection tools.

faqs.question: Does QuillBot integrate with Google Docs and Microsoft Word?
faqs.answer: Yes. QuillBot offers a native Google Docs add-on and a Microsoft Word add-in, plus browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.

faqs.question: Is QuillBot safe for academic use?
faqs.answer: QuillBot is widely used by students, but users should always follow their institution's academic integrity policies when using paraphrasing or AI writing tools.

name: Bardeen

The platform has raised $25.3 million and is backed by HubSpot Ventures, Dropbox Ventures, and Insight Partners.

faqs.question: What is Bardeen used for?
faqs.answer: Bardeen automates repetitive browser-based tasks for go-to-market teams - including web scraping, lead enrichment, CRM data entry, and multi-step sales workflows - without writing code.

faqs.question: Does Bardeen require coding skills?
faqs.answer: No. Bardeen lets users describe automations in plain English or choose from 100+ pre-built templates, requiring no coding or server infrastructure.

faqs.question: What browsers does Bardeen support?
faqs.answer: Bardeen currently runs exclusively as a Chrome extension. It does not support Firefox, Safari, or other browsers.

faqs.question: How does Bardeen pricing work?
faqs.answer: Bardeen uses a credit-based system. The free plan includes 100 credits/month. Paid plans start at $10/month (Basic, 200 credits) and $50/month (Premium, 1,000 credits). Enterprise pricing is custom.

faqs.question: Which CRMs does Bardeen integrate with?
faqs.answer: Bardeen natively integrates with HubSpot and Salesforce, and also connects with Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, and LinkedIn.

faqs.question: Is there a free plan for Bardeen?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bardeen offers a free plan with 100 credits per month that refreshes at each billing period, covering basic scraping and automation tasks.

The platform integrates with Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, and other cloud data warehouses, and serves financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology sectors.

faqs.question: What is ThoughtSpot used for?
faqs.answer: ThoughtSpot is used for business intelligence and analytics. It lets non-technical users query live data in natural language and get AI-generated insights, dashboards, and automated recommendations.

faqs.question: How does ThoughtSpot Spotter work?
faqs.answer: Spotter is ThoughtSpot's AI agent that acts as an automated data analyst. Users ask business questions in plain language and Spotter autonomously queries data, generates visualizations, and surfaces relevant insights.

faqs.question: What data sources does ThoughtSpot connect to?
faqs.answer: ThoughtSpot connects to major cloud data warehouses including Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, and Microsoft Azure Synapse.

faqs.question: How much does ThoughtSpot cost?
faqs.answer: ThoughtSpot Essentials starts at $25/user/month (billed annually, 5-50 users). The Pro tier is usage-based at $0.10 per query. Enterprise pricing is custom. An Embedded Developer plan is free for the first year.

faqs.question: Does ThoughtSpot support embedded analytics?
faqs.answer: Yes. ThoughtSpot offers low-code APIs and SDKs so product teams can embed AI-powered analytics directly within their own applications.

faqs.question: Who founded ThoughtSpot and when?
faqs.answer: ThoughtSpot was founded in 2012 by Ajeet Singh and Amit Prakash in Mountain View, California. The company has raised over $600 million in funding and achieved a $4.2 billion valuation.

faqs.question: What is Teachable used for?
faqs.answer: Teachable is used to create and sell online courses, coaching programs, digital downloads, and membership communities. It is designed for creators, educators, and businesses who want to monetize knowledge and expertise.

faqs.question: Does Teachable have a free plan?
faqs.answer: Teachable does not offer a permanent free plan, but it provides a free trial. The entry-level Starter plan begins at $39/month (or $29/month billed annually).

faqs.question: How much does Teachable cost?
faqs.answer: Teachable plans start at $39/month (Starter), $89/month (Builder), and $189/month (Growth). Annual billing reduces prices to $29, $69, and $139/month respectively. A Custom enterprise plan is also available.

faqs.question: Does Teachable charge transaction fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Starter plan charges a 7.5% transaction fee on sales. The Builder, Growth, and Custom plans have 0% transaction fees.

faqs.question: What AI features does Teachable offer?
faqs.answer: Teachable includes an AI Curriculum Generator (creates course outlines from a description), an AI Quiz Generator, and automatic video subtitle and translation in 70+ languages.

faqs.question: Does Teachable integrate with Zapier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teachable's Growth plan and above include Zapier access, enabling connections to 150+ external tools including Shopify, Discord, Salesforce, Zoom, and Mailchimp.

name: Be My Eyes
tagline: AI and volunteer-powered app giving blind and low-vision users real-time visual assistance in over 180 languages, 24/7.
description: Be My Eyes is a Danish accessibility company founded in 2015 by Hans Jorgen Wiberg, a craftsman with low vision. Its app connects blind and visually impaired users with sighted volunteers via live video, and with its Be My AI feature (powered by GPT-4 vision), provides instant AI-generated visual descriptions without a human intermediary. The service is free for consumers and available in 150+ countries; business solutions are offered for enterprises seeking to serve visually impaired customers and employees.

faqs.question: Is Be My Eyes free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Be My Eyes consumer app is completely free for blind and low-vision users. There is no subscription, trial period, or paywall. Business and enterprise solutions have custom pricing.

faqs.question: What is Be My AI?
faqs.answer: Be My AI is an AI-powered feature within the Be My Eyes app, built on OpenAI's GPT-4 vision model. It provides instant, detailed descriptions of images and scenes without needing a human volunteer.

faqs.question: When was Be My Eyes founded?
faqs.answer: Be My Eyes was founded in 2015 by Hans Jorgen Wiberg, a Danish craftsman with low vision. Within 24 hours of launch, 10,000 volunteers had signed up.

faqs.question: What platforms does Be My Eyes support?
faqs.answer: Be My Eyes is available on iOS, Android, and Windows. It also integrates with Meta Ray-Ban and Oakley Meta smart glasses for hands-free use.

faqs.question: How does Be My Eyes work for businesses?
faqs.answer: Businesses can list in the Be My Eyes Service Directory so visually impaired customers can reach trained support teams directly. Enterprise solutions include Service AI, Service Connect, and Be My Eyes Workplace for employee accessibility.

faqs.question: How many people use Be My Eyes?
faqs.answer: As of 2026, Be My Eyes has over 10.5 million sighted volunteers and approximately 1 million blind or low-vision users across 150+ countries and 180+ languages.
